title: facet
description: A single facet for a specific filter. Every facet has a human-readable name and total count to show to end-users to drill down search results.

name.title: name
name.description: An internationalized name with one or more localized names.

nl.title: name.localized
nl.description: A human-readable name in the `nl` (Dutch) language.

fr.title: name.localized
fr.description: A human-readable name in the `fr` (French) language.

de.title: name.localized
de.description: A human-readable name in the `de` (German) language.

en.title: name.localized
en.description: A human-readable name in the `en` (English) language.

count.description: Total results if the filter is applied with this value (= the key referencing this object).

children.description: Children facets, in the case of filters with a hierarchy.
